svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the blank 242 wide x 270 tall from 6 mm plate; square, deburr,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the corners to about 3 mm. Front view is the reactor side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure across from the left edge and up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp studs: two M8 tapped holes (drill 6.8) 112 across, 65 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 195 up. The reactor axis is 112 from the left edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Enclosure: four M4 tapped holes (drill 3.3) 182 and 226 across,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saddles: four 4.5 mm holes 25 across, 15, 29, 241 and 255 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersink them on the back (wall) face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wall: four 5.5 mm holes 7 and 234 across, 10 and 260 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole on both faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the saddles and the enclosure on it and look through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each hole; the holes line up without forcing a screw.
